root_cause: Supabase CLI 2.119.0 renders migration versions inside Markdown backticks; the fail-closed drift parser required bare 14-digit cells and therefore discarded every row.
invariant: Migration repair may proceed only when parsed pre-repair drift equals the exact four-version allowlist and post-repair drift is zero.
prevention_rule: Normalize presentation-only backticks from each migration-list cell before validating 14-digit version identities; never weaken the exact drift allowlist.
